# Looking along the rows

Every value so far has been worked out from one row, or from a whole group at
once. This part is about values that need the other rows without collapsing
them: a rank, a row number, a running total, the value one row back.

These are window functions, and they are where most tools get complicated. Here
they are ordinary things to write inside `add`, with one rule attached: several
of them need a `sort` in front, because a total *so far* means nothing until
something has said in what order.

If you have written `OVER (PARTITION BY ...)` in SQL, this part is the short
version of it.
